name: Tulip Protocol
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Tulip Protocol, a Solana ecological income aggregator and leveraged income farming platform, stated that its exposure to the Mango attack was limited to a portion of the USDC/RAY strategic treasury, namely 2,465,841.497167 USDC and 66,721.925355 RAY, and the funds affected by the Mango attack were about $2.5 million.
